title: ERD §0: documented new-shortcut workflow + send-to-vscode prototype + new-shortcut.sh helper
body:
Closes ERD §0 (`new-shortcut workflow`).

## What

| Sub-item | Deliverable |
|----------|-------------|
| §0.1 | `scripts/send-to-vscode.sh` — first hand-built non-iTerm target (cliclick-paste strategy, bundle id `com.microsoft.VSCode`). Verified end-to-end with **Sticky Keys ON**. |
| §0.2 | `README.md` → new **Adding a new shortcut** section: pick the right base script, find a bundle id, the four edits, wire-up via `install.sh`, first-trigger permission prompts, Sticky-Keys verification. |
| §0.3 | `scripts/new-shortcut.sh` — minimum-viable generator. `--name`, `--bundle-id`, optional `--base` (defaults to `send-to-vscode.sh` since cliclick-paste is the more general strategy). Substitutes Raycast title + description + `TARGET_BUNDLE_ID` + failure-notification title; `chmod +x`; re-runs `install.sh` to symlink. `--force` to overwrite. |
| §0.4 | `ROADMAP.md` §2 → cross-link back to §0, marking the larger §2 generator as a graduation of `new-shortcut.sh` rather than a from-scratch design. |

## Supporting changes

- `install.sh` now skips `scripts/*.sh` files without an `@raycast.schemaVersion` header, so helpers like `new-shortcut.sh` don't end up as broken Raycast commands.
- `scripts/send-to-vscode.sh` description and step-6 comment genericized so generated copies read cleanly.

## Verification

- §0.1: dictated → `Send to VS Code` hotkey → text landed in active editor pane with Sticky Keys ON, no fix-ups needed.
- §0.3 smoke test: `./scripts/new-shortcut.sh --name "Notes" --bundle-id com.apple.Notes` produced a `send-to-notes.sh` whose diff against `send-to-vscode.sh` is exactly four targeted substitutions (title, description, bundle id, notification title) and nothing else. Smoke-test artifact removed afterwards; user can regenerate on demand. End-to-end paste-into-Notes verification deferred to the user.

## Out of scope (deferred to ROADMAP §2)

- Strategy templates (`applescript` vs. `cliclick-paste` picker).
- Bundle-id auto-detection from the most-recent frontmost app.
- `& Run` companion scripts.
- A picker UI / per-target config file.
